title: The Parable of the Sheep and the Goats
description: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all the angels, he will sit on his glorious throne. All nations are gathered before him, and he separates them from one another as a shepherd separates sheep from goats. He places the sheep on his right hand and the goats on the left. Then the king says to those on his right: "Come here, you who are blessed by my Father, and inherit the kingdom prepared for you since the foundation of the world. For I was hungry and you gave me food; I was thirsty and you gave me drink; I was a stranger and you welcomed me; naked, sick, and in prison, and you cared for me." The righteous ask when they did this, and he answers: "Whatever you did for one of the least of these my brothers, you did it for me." To those on his left he says the opposite and sends them away to eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels. These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.

versions.title: The Parable of the Sheep and the Goats
versions.description: When the Son of Man comes in his glory, he will sit on his throne and separate the nations from each other as a shepherd separates sheep from goats. To those on his right he says: "Come here, you who are blessed by my Father. For I was hungry, and you gave me food ..." They ask when they did this, and he answers: "Whatever you did for one of these least brothers of mine, you did for me." To those on the left he says the opposite. And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
